podcast.title: First Techno Record Label (1985)
podcast.body: Metroplex was founded in 1985 by Juan Atkins, making it the first record label specifically dedicated to techno music. "él hizo la primera discográfica de música de techno en 1985 Metroplex."

srcs.episode: La historia del TECHNO en DETROIT. Cómo la música salvó a una ciudad atrapada

podcast.title: Juan Atkins' Independent Venture
podcast.body: Founded by Juan Atkins after the split of Cybotron, Metroplex became his personal record label. It was a vital platform for releasing not only his own music as Model 500 but also for supporting and showcasing other like-minded techno producers. "Para el elamente, establece su propio sello discográfico, Metroplex, donde no solo lanzaría su propia música, sino también la de otros productores afines."
